description: This document describes manual data hiding operations within Btrfs superblock regions. Hidden data were embedded at multiple offsets inside both primary and backup superblocks using direct byte-level modification via dd. CRC32C checksums were recalculated to maintain integrity of the superblock structure.
plaintext_preview: HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA ...
notes: The Btrfs superblock is replicated across the device at multiple fixed offsets (64 KiB, 64 MiB, etc.).
Hidden data were inserted between metadata fields and padding bytes to avoid corruption.
CRC32C checksums ensure structural consistency of modified superblocks.
This demonstrates metadata-level data hiding within Btrfs structures.
